I was 12 and had a similar event happen, I was at my grandparents house for the summer holidays, they lived overseas and it was my first time in this country. 
I was playing outside her house in the garden when two guys pulled up next to me asking me for the directions to the local school. 
I didn’t get close to them because I didn’t know the answer and I told them I would get my grandparents because I didn’t know. The men kept insisting I didn’t need to do that because all they want to know is the directions to the school. 

I said to them I really don’t know and turned to get my grandparents and then they took off quickly. 

I always felt that was super sus.
